value.agent-plugins-1-0-in-vs-code-copilot-cli: GitHub released Agent Plugins 1.0, extending Copilot's agentic capabilities; developers can now build and distribute custom agent extensions, enabling new automation workflows.
value.the-new-github-copilot-experience-in-sla: GitHub Copilot now integrates with Slack, letting teams interact with Copilot agents directly in chat, lowering the barrier to AI-assisted development.
value.shared-agentic-work-with-github-copilot-: GitHub Copilot now supports shared agentic work in Microsoft Teams, enabling multiple team members to collaborate on AI tasks, making AI assistance a team sport.
value.copilot-memory-and-ollama-in-github-copi: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now features memory, retaining context across sessions, and Ollama support, enabling local models for privacy-conscious developers.
value.github-enterprise-server-3-22-release-ca: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is a release candidate for self-hosted deployments; enterprise teams should evaluate it for upcoming Copilot and security features.
value.grok-4-6-is-now-available-in-github-copi: xAI's Grok 4.6 model is now available in GitHub Copilot, expanding developer choices to pick the best tool for each task.
value.gemini-3-7-flash-is-now-available-in-git: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash model is now in GitHub Copilot, offering a fast, capable option for high-frequency coding tasks where latency matters.
value.mai-code-1-1-flash-available-in-github-c: Microsoft's MAI-Code-1.1-Flash model is now in GitHub Copilot, providing an upgraded AI code model for developers, potentially improving code quality.
value.codeql-2-26-3-improves-github-actions-qu: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves security analysis for GitHub Actions and JavaScript, meaning more vulnerabilities are caught earlier, improving supply-chain security.
value.credential-revocation-and-deauthorizatio: GitHub now allows credential revocation by token type, giving finer-grained control over access management and reducing blast radius if credentials are compromised.
